function: Joint active beamforming at APs and discrete passive IRS phase configuration, maximizing sum secrecy rate under imperfect CSI (p. 8)
system: Cell-free massive MIMO downlink, 8 APs x 4 antennas, 4 single-antenna users, 2 eavesdroppers, 2 passive reflecting IRSs (16-256 elements, 3-bit phase), 3.5 GHz (pp. 5, 16)
method: Dual-loop meta-reinforcement learning: MAML policy for AP beamforming plus deep Q-network for discrete IRS phases; offline meta-training on 100 tasks, online fine-tuning (pp. 8, 12)
data_channel: Custom MATLAB simulator: 3GPP UMi path loss, 8 dB shadowing, correlated Rayleigh direct and Rician (3 dB) cascaded links, imperfect CSI, channel aging; 1000 realizations (p. 16)
test_conditions: Trained on 100 meta-tasks (positions, CSI error 0.05-0.4, 3-5 bit phases); tested on unseen user-eavesdropper configurations after 10-50 updates; CSI error swept to 0.5 (pp. 4, 18)
baselines: Non-learned: CF-mMIMO without IRS, alternating optimization, SDP relaxation, manifold optimization, two-timescale optimization; learned: DDPG-based IRS control (pp. 16-17)
metrics: Sum secrecy rate, energy efficiency, iterations to 90% of final rate, robustness retention, per-iteration runtime and complexity (pp. 17-18, 21)
complexity: Per-iteration order O(P + T Nt |F| dQ + LMKT Nt), about 2.9e5 operations; runtime 1.8-8.2 ms for Nt 64-256; memory about 60 MB (pp. 15-16, 21)
q1_support: p. 16: "using custom implementations aligned with the system model in Section III"; the channel is a custom simulator whose path loss alone follows 3GPP UMi, so q1 is not met (the ray-tracing and measurement claim of p. 12 is discussed in notes).
q2_support: p. 18: "for a new user and eavesdropper configuration not seen during training"; the meta-learned model adapts with 10-50 online gradient updates (pp. 12, 18).
q3_support: p. 17: "DDPG-based IRS control [8] applies deep deterministic policy gradients"; p. 16: "Alternating Optimization (AO) [2] iteratively updates AP beamforming via weighted MMSE"; both compared on sum secrecy rate (Fig. 3 and Table 7, p. 17).
q4_support: p. 15: "including both asymptotic order notation and concrete numerical evaluations"; Eq. (58) gives the order and Table 4 about 2.9e5 operations per iteration; Table 10 (p. 21) gives runtime in ms.
q5_support: p. 16: "using custom implementations aligned with the system model in Section III"; no code or data link is given, no public channel dataset is used, and the ray-traced data of p. 12 is not released.
notes: Included, area 3: Meta-RL (MAML) for AP precoding plus a DQN for discrete IRS phases, objective sum secrecy rate; the anti-jamming test (p. 19) is only an extra evaluation. q1 is set to 0 on a contradiction for the reviewer to confirm: p. 12 says the meta-training tasks use ray-tracing "compliant with the 3GPP TR 38.901 channel models" and that validation on "20 real-world measurement campaigns" was done, but p. 16 describes custom MATLAB simulations with 3GPP UMi path loss only, no ray-tracing or measured-data results are shown, and p. 22 lists "hardware prototyping and real-world testbed validation" as next steps. If the reviewer accepts the p. 12 statement, q1 would be 1. q2 rests on the Fig. 5 adaptation to a new configuration (p. 18), not on the CSI-error or Doppler sweeps.
